QUOTE: The library itself: `library/common.h:132` has `#define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`. That header is internal, not installed under `include/`. The library's `.c` files and internal headers include it... so inside the library every field is accessed by its real name.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the library-internal header common.h defines the opt-out, so all library translation units see the plain member names.
